payout_quote: Offer is limited to the first two thousand (2,000) new Golden 1 Credit Union (Golden 1) members who open a Savings or Checking account at the Golden 1 Fresno State Branch, 3046 E Campus Pointe Dr. Fresno, CA 93710, August 1, 2026, through October 31, 2026.
steps: Open a new Checking or Savings account in person at the Golden 1 Fresno State Branch (3046 E Campus Pointe Dr, Fresno, CA 93710) between August 1, 2026 and October 31, 2026
Complete at least one qualifying deposit of $500 or more into that account by October 31, 2026
Keep the account open and in good standing; Golden 1 deposits the $100 bonus after deposit verification, no later than November 30, 2026
catches: Branch-specific offer - must open the account at the single Fresno State branch address; not available at other Golden 1 branches or online
Limited to the first 2,000 new members at that branch - the offer can run out before the 10/31/2026 end date
Not available to anyone who has owned or jointly owned a Golden 1 checking or savings account within the last 24 months
Only one $100 bonus per member even if both a checking and a savings account are opened; fiduciary/business accounts and Golden 1 employees excluded
Bonus is reported as taxable income
Golden 1 may change or discontinue the offer at any time without notice
biggest_catch: This only works at one specific branch - the Fresno State campus branch in Fresno, California - and is capped at the first 2,000 new members, so it is only useful if you live near Fresno and get there early.
eligibility: New Golden 1 members who open a checking or savings account at the Fresno State branch between 8/1/2026 and 10/31/2026; no Golden 1 checking/savings ownership within the past 24 months; among the first 2,000 qualifying new members.
timing: $500+ qualifying deposit due by 10/31/2026; $100 bonus deposited after verification, no later than 11/30/2026.
weasel_words: Golden 1 may change or discontinue these offers at any time before this date without notice
